name: Dewdrop
summary: A round drop of frosted glass on drifting colour that holds a sign-in and sign-up form
about: A sign-in form inside a round piece of frosted glass that floats over slowly drifting colour blobs and tilts toward your pointer with a moving highlight. A stretchy switch flips between sign in and sign up, the glass wobbles, and the name field grows in. Fields check themselves, a ring of light runs around the edge while it works, and success ends in a splash of droplets. Good for the login page of an app or website.
how: Pick Sign in or Sign up with the switch (click, or arrow keys); the glass wobbles and the fields slide in.
Fill in the fields and press the button; empty or wrong fields turn red, say what is wrong and the glass shakes.
While it works the button turns into a spinner and a ring of light runs around the edge of the glass.
On success the ring turns green, droplets splash off the edge and a welcome view appears; Sign out brings the form back.
Type the password wrongpass to see the error state; with reduced motion every state still shows without the big movement.
